Troubleshooting · 10/50 · media

No verified set backup

Failure signal

A no verified set backup condition is reported or detected during media.

Likely cause

The controlling record, technical state or approved specification for media does not match the current asset or workflow.

Verification

Count independent copies and verify hashes before formatting any capture media.

Corrective action

Create and verify the missing copy, then record custody and checksum evidence.

Prevention

Add this verification to the media gate, retain immutable evidence and assign one accountable owner.
